bagPolicy.summary: Guests attending public ticketed events at UW – Panther Arena are allowed to bring a clear stadium bag up to 12″ x 6″ x 12″, a gallon-sized clear zip bag, a wristlet up to 4″x6″x1″, or a diaper or medical bag. Bags will be searched upon entry.
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions and will be searched.

parking.note: The Baird Center Garage offers convenient indoor parking with easy access to events at UW-Milwaukee Panther Arena and nearby venues. Additional parking options are available throughout downtown Milwaukee, including street spots and nearby garages.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by UW – Panther Arena. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: UW-Milwaukee Panther Arena offers a diverse range of food and beverage options through its partner, Levy Restaurants. The menu includes quality concessions, backstage catering, and elegant banquet options, with dietary accommodations noted for gluten-free, nut, seafood, vegan, and vegetarian preferences.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Only service animals that meet federal guidelines are allowed; support animals and other animals are not permitted. Two arena restrooms are not fully accessible, and nearby parking lots and structures also have ADA spaces.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in UW – Panther Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Will Call tickets must be picked up at the box office on the day of the event by the guest named on the tickets, with a valid photo ID. Pickup restrictions can vary by event.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The arena entrance is at 400 W. Kilbourn Ave. Door times vary by event and are listed on the event page.
